recognize_zh: 細胞密集的抹片中，顆粒球系明顯佔多數，視野中央多顆成熟嗜中性球的核分成 4–5 個小而圓、彼此分離的核葉，僅以細絲相連，部分細胞質帶細小空泡；前驅細胞（前髓細胞、髓細胞）仍在但成熟型居多，符合骨髓滯留症（myelokathexis）。
features: Cellular aspirate with granulocytic predominance and full maturation, weighted toward mature neutrophils
Central neutrophils with hypersegmented nuclei composed of 4-5 small, round, condensed, separated lobes joined by thin filaments
Subtle cytoplasmic vacuolation in some mature neutrophils
Admixed promyelocytes/myelocytes with pink granules, metamyelocytes and bands; one eosinophil (center)
Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes; no increase in blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows granulocytic predominance with complete maturation. Numerous mature neutrophils, best seen in the center of the field, have hyperlobated nuclei composed of small, round, dense lobes separated from one another and connected by thin chromatin filaments, with focal cytoplasmic vacuolation. Promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, an eosinophil, scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are also present, and blasts are not increased. Given peripheral neutropenia with warts, hypogammaglobulinemia and infections, these findings are consistent with myelokathexis in WHIM syndrome.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic marrow shows giant metamyelocytes/bands and megaloblastic erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, while here precursors are normoblastic and the abnormality is pyknotic filament-joined lobes.
MDS favors hypolobated pseudo-Pelger and hypogranular neutrophils with multilineage dysplasia, not uniform hypersegmented separated lobes with normal granulation.
G-CSF causes left-shifted hyperplasia with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies rather than apoptotic-appearing, filament-joined neutrophil nuclei.
